data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to share content, images, and videos to various social media platforms.
data.what_it_does: Allows sharing of text, single media files, or multiple media files directly to social media apps like Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, Telegram, Reddit, and LinkedIn. It handles platform differences and can redirect to a browser if the target app is not installed.
use_when: You need to share text, images, or videos from your app directly to specific social media platforms.
You require fallback handling or browser redirection when the target social app is not installed.
avoid_when: You only need a generic system share sheet rather than targeting specific social apps.
You are building for platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Supports multiple media sharing (images and videos) at once.
Provides unified interface for multiple social platforms.
Includes customizable handling when apps are missing.
weaknesses: Requires specific AndroidManifest configuration (queries and FileProvider setup).
Limited to Android and iOS platforms.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding app queries for package names and a FileProvider XML configuration in AndroidManifest.xml for Android. No special configuration is needed for iOS.

alternatives.name: share_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick share_plus if you want to use the native system share sheet rather than targeting specific individual social media applications.
